invariants.rationale: The method requires 'profile' to perform partition and workload logic; it should be non-null.
The method makes use of 'context' for workload operations, so it must not be null.
Partition paths obtained from 'profile' are iterated in the method, so should be non-null.
The set of partition paths is never negative in size (though this is trivial, it's more structural than tautological, as set size cannot be negative in Java).
If workload stats are available, their map should also be non-null.
